{"parentUuid":"c4eed12f-46d4-4c66-b074-a0380766f770","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ns6z36fs3n6xnluuyyd05i3v","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/a/internal/twopc/participant.go","content":"package twopc\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/wal\"\n)\n\n// 参与者 WAL 记录类型。\nconst (\n\trecPartPrepared  = \"PART_PREPARED\"  // {txnId} 准备就绪（持锁，不得自行回滚）\n\trecPartCommitted = \"PART_COMMITTED\" // {txnId} 已提交\n\trecPartAborted   = \"PART_ABORTED\"   // {txnId} 已中止\n)\n\ntype partTxn struct {\n\tstate     string // prepared | committed | aborted\n\tlockHeld  bool\n\tsinceTick int64\n}\n\n// Participant 是 2PC 参与者（模拟本地资源管理器）。\ntype Participant struct {\n\tid         string\n\tcoordID    string\n\tpeers      []string // 另外两个参与者（终止协议询问对象）\n\ttimings    Timings\n\tlog        *wal.WAL\n\tctx        Context\n\ttxns       map[string]*partTxn\n\tvoteNo     map[string]bool // txnID -> 本地投否决（场景可配）\n\tquerying   map[string]bool // 防止重复安排询问定时器\n}\n\n// NewParticipant 创建参与者。voteNoTxns 中的事务本地拒绝提交。\nfunc NewParticipant(id, coordID string, peers []string, timings Timings, log *wal.WAL, voteNoTxns []string) *Participant {\n\tvoteNo := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, t := range voteNoTxns {\n\t\tvoteNo[t] = true\n\t}\n\treturn &Participant{\n\t\tid:       id,\n\t\tcoordID:  coordID,\n\t\tpeers:    append([]string(nil), peers...),\n\t\ttimings:  timings,\n\t\tlog:      log,\n\t\ttxns:     map[string]*partTxn{},\n\t\tvoteNo:   voteNo,\n\t\tquerying: map[string]bool{},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) Bind(ctx Context) { p.ctx = ctx }\n\nfunc (p *Participant) ID() string { return p.id }\n\n// Begin 对参与者无意义（事务由协调者发起）。\nfunc (p *Participant) Begin(string) {}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) OnMessage(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgPrepare:\n\t\tp.onPrepare(m)\n\tcase MsgGlobalCommit:\n\t\tp.onGlobalDecision(m, true)\n\tcase MsgGlobalAbort:\n\t\tp.onGlobalDecision(m, false)\n\tcase MsgDecisionRequest:\n\t\tp.onDecisionRequest(m)\n\tcase MsgDecisionCommit:\n\t\tp.onPeerDecision(m, true)\n\tcase MsgDecisionAbort:\n\t\tp.onPeerDecision(m, false)\n\t}\n}\n\n// onPrepare 处理第一阶段：本地决定后先写 WAL 再回复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onPrepare(m Message) {\n\tif t := p.txns[m.TxnID]; t != nil {\n\t\t// 幂等：重发的 PREPARE。已 PREPARED 的重新投票；终态不再响应。\n\t\tswitch t.state {\n\t\tcase StatePrepared:\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.prepare.duplicate\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"action\": \"revote-commit\"})\n\t\tcase StateCommitted:\n\t\t\t// 协调者显然错过了决议结果，直接补发 ACK 帮助其收敛。\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 本地资源检查（模拟）：场景配置为否决时拒绝。\n\tif p.voteNo[m.TxnID] {\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.localAbort\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"reason\": \"vote-no\"})\n\t\t// 投否决前可以先写 ABORTED（崩溃恢复后仍知道自己已单方中止）。\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforePrepared, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif err := p.log.Append(recPartPrepared, txnRec{TxnID: m.TxnID}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tpt := &partTxn{state: StatePrepared, lockHeld: true, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\tp.txns[m.TxnID] = pt\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.prepared.fsynced\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"lockHeld\": true})\n\n\t// 协议保证：PREPARED 之后绝不自行超时回滚。\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterPrepared, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeVote, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.voteCommit.sent\", m.TxnID, nil)\n\n\t// 开始周期性询问决议（不是回滚定时器！）。\n\tp.startQuerying(m.TxnID)\n}\n\n// onGlobalDecision 处理第二阶段决议：幂等，先 fsync 再 ACK。\nfunc (p *Participant) onGlobalDecision(m Message, commit bool) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif t != nil {\n\t\t// 终态收到重发：仅补 ACK。\n\t\tif (commit && t.state == StateCommitted) || (!commit && t.state == StateAborted) {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !commit && t.state == StatePrepared {\n\t\t\t// 合法路径\n\t\t} else if commit && t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.protocolViolation\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\"reason\": \"commit without prepared\", \"state\": t.state,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// t == nil 且收到 GLOBAL_ABORT：可能是 PREPARE 丢失或节点曾在无记录时崩溃，\n\t// 中止总是安全的，补写 ABORTED 并 ACK。\n\tif t == nil && commit {\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.protocolViolation\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"reason\": \"commit for unknown txn\",\n\t\t})\n\t\t// 仍按协调者决议执行（协调者日志是唯一权威），但留下冲突证据。\n\t}\n\n\tif commit {\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeCommit, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartCommitted, StateCommitted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterCommit, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tdelete(p.querying, m.TxnID) // 决议已达，停止询问\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.ack.sent\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"decision\": m.Type})\n}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) writeTerminal(txnID, recType, state string, lock bool) {\n\tif err := p.log.Append(recType, txnRec{TxnID: txnID}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tif t := p.txns[txnID]; t != nil {\n\t\tt.state = state\n\t\tt.lockHeld = lock\n\t} else {\n\t\tp.txns[txnID] = &partTxn{state: state, lockHeld: lock, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t}\n}\n\n// startQuerying 安排周期性决议询问。PREPARED 后参与者只能等——\n// 没有协调者（或持决议的同伴）答复前，锁一直持有，绝不中止。\nfunc (p *Participant) startQuerying(txnID string) {\n\tif p.querying[txnID] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.querying[txnID] = true\n\tp.ctx.Timer(TimerQuery, txnID, p.timings.Query)\n}\n\n// onDecisionRequest 处理同伴询问：只有自己处于确定状态时才能答复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onDecisionRequest(m Message) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif t == nil {\n\t\t// 自己没有任何记录 => 从未投过赞成票，事务中止是安全的。\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tswitch t.state {\n\tcase StateCommitted:\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tcase StateAborted:\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tcase StatePrepared:\n\t\t// 同样在等决议：无法帮助对方，保持沉默（对方继续阻塞）。\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.query.peererWait\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t}\n}\n\n// onPeerDecision 处理终止协议答复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onPeerDecision(m Message, commit bool) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\t// 只有处于 PREPARED 的询问者才需要按答复行动。\n\tif t == nil || t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif commit {\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartCommitted, StateCommitted, false)\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.commit.fromPeer\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t\t// 同伴决议也视为终态；协调者恢复后通过重发 PREPARE 或 ACK 交换收敛。\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\t} else {\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.abort.fromPeer\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\t}\n\tdelete(p.querying, m.TxnID)\n}\n\n// OnTimer 处理询问定时器：向协调者与所有同伴发 DECISION_REQUEST。\nfunc (p *Participant) OnTimer(kind, txnID string) {\n\tif kind != TimerQuery {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tt := p.txns[txnID]\n\tif t == nil || t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\tdelete(p.querying, txnID)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 仍处于 PREPARED：继续等，继续问。这不是超时回滚。\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.query.tick\", txnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"waitedTicks\": p.ctx.Now() - t.sinceTick, \"lockHeld\": true,\n\t})\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionRequest, TxnID: txnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\tfor _, peer := range p.peers {\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionRequest, TxnID: txnID, From: p.id, To: peer})\n\t}\n\tp.ctx.Timer(TimerQuery, txnID, p.timings.Query)\n}\n\n// Recover 重放 WAL；PREPARED 事务恢复后重新持锁并继续等待决议。\nfunc (p *Participant) Recover() {\n\tp.txns = map[string]*partTxn{}\n\terr := p.log.Replay(func(r wal.Record) error {\n\t\tvar d txnRec\n\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(r.Data, &d); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch r.Type {\n\t\tcase recPartPrepared:\n\t\t\t// 可能后面还有同事务的终态记录，先标记，后续覆盖。\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StatePrepared, lockHeld: true, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\tcase recPartCommitted:\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StateCommitted, lockHeld: false, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\tcase recPartAborted:\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StateAborted, lockHeld: false, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tfor id, t := range p.txns {\n\t\tif t.state == StatePrepared {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.recover.prepared\", id, map[string]any{\"lockHeld\": true})\n\t\t\tp.startQuerying(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.recover.terminal\", id, map[string]any{\"state\": t.state})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Snapshot 输出参与者当前状态。\nfunc (p *Participant) Snapshot() NodeSnapshot {\n\tstates := map[string]TxnView{}\n\tfor id, t := range p.txns {\n\t\tstates[id] = TxnView{State: t.state, LockHeld: t.lockHeld, SinceTick: t.sinceTick}\n\t}\n\treturn NodeSnapshot{ID: p.id, Role: \"participant\", TxnStates: states}\n}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) Close() error { return p.log.Close() \"PART_COMMITTED\" // {txnId} 已提交\n\trecPartAborted   = \"PART_ABORTED\"   // {txnId} 已中止\n)\n\ntype partTxn struct {\n\tstate     string // prepared | committed | aborted\n\tlockHeld NewParticipant 创建参与者。voteNoTxns 中的事务本地拒绝提交。\nfunc NewParticipant(id, coordID string, peers []string, timings Timings, log *wal.WAL, voteNoTxns []string) *Participant {\n\tvoteNo := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, t := range voteNoTxns {\n\t\tvoteNo[t] = true\n\t}\n\treturn &Participant{\n\t\tid:       id,\n\t\tcoordID:  coordID,\n\t\tpeers:    append([]string(nil), peers...),\n\t\ttimings:  timings,\n\t\tlog:      log,\n\t\ttxns:     map[string]*partTxn{},\n\t\tvoteNo:   voteNo,\n\t\tquerying: map[string]bool{},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) Bind(ctx Context) { p.ctx = ctx }\n\nfunc (p *Participant) ID() string { return p.id }\n\n// Begin 对参与者无意义（事务由协调者发起）。\nfunc (p *Participant) Begin(string) {}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) OnMessage(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgPrepare:\n\t\tp.onPrepare(m)\n\tcase MsgGlobalCommit:\n\t\tp.onGlobalDecision(m, true)\n\tcase MsgGlobalAbort:\n\t\tp.onGlobalDecision(m, false)\n\tcase MsgDecisionRequest:\n\t\tp.onDecisionRequest(m)\n\tcase MsgDecisionCommit:\n\t\tp.onPeerDecision(m, true)\n\tcase MsgDecisionAbort:\n\t\tp.onPeerDecision(m, false)\n\t}\n}\n\n// onPrepare 处理第一阶段：本地决定后先写 WAL 再回复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onPrepare(m Message) {\n\tif t := p.txns[m.TxnID]; t != nil {\n\t\t// 幂等：重发的 PREPARE。已 PREPARED 的重新投票；终态不再响应。\n\t\tswitch t.state {\n\t\tcase StatePrepared:\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.prepare.duplicate\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"action\": \"revote-commit\"})\n\t\tcase StateCommitted:\n\t\t\t// 协调者显然错过了决议结果，直接补发 ACK 帮助其收敛。\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 本地资源检查（模拟）：场景配置为否决时拒绝。\n\tif p.voteNo[m.TxnID] {\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.localAbort\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"reason\": \"vote-no\"})\n\t\t// 投否决前可以先写 ABORTED（崩溃恢复后仍知道自己已单方中止）。\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforePrepared, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif err := p.log.Append(recPartPrepared, txnRec{TxnID: m.TxnID}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tpt := &partTxn{state: StatePrepared, lockHeld: true, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\tp.txns[m.TxnID] = pt\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.prepared.fsynced\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"lockHeld\": true})\n\n\t// 协议保证：PREPARED 之后绝不自行超时回滚。\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterPrepared, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeVote, m.TxnID) {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.voteCommit.sent\", m.TxnID, nil)\n\n\t// 开始周期性询问决议（不是回滚定时器！）。\n\tp.startQuerying(m.TxnID)\n}\n\n// onGlobalDecision 处理第二阶段决议：幂等，先 fsync 再 ACK。\nfunc (p *Participant) onGlobalDecision(m Message, commit bool) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif t != nil {\n\t\t// 终态收到重发：仅补 ACK。\n\t\tif (commit && t.state == StateCommitted) || (!commit && t.state == StateAborted) {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !commit && t.state == StatePrepared {\n\t\t\t// 合法路径\n\t\t} else if commit && t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.protocolViolation\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\t\"reason\": \"commit without prepared\", \"state\": t.state,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// t == nil 且收到 GLOBAL_ABORT：可能是 PREPARE 丢失或节点曾在无记录时崩溃，\n\t// 中止总是安全的，补写 ABORTED 并 ACK。\n\tif t == nil && commit {\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.protocolViolation\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\t\"reason\": \"commit for unknown txn\",\n\t\t})\n\t\t// 仍按协调者决议执行（协调者日志是唯一权威），但留下冲突证据。\n\t}\n\n\tif commit {\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeCommit, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartCommitted, StateCommitted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterCommit, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t} else {\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartBeforeAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tif p.ctx.Hook(HookPartAfterAbort, m.TxnID) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tdelete(p.querying, m.TxnID) // 决议已达，停止询问\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.ack.sent\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"decision\": m.Type})\n}\n\nfunc (p *Participant) writeTerminal(txnID, recType, state string, lock bool) {\n\tif err := p.log.Append(recType, txnRec{TxnID: txnID}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tif t := p.txns[txnID]; t != nil {\n\t\tt.state = state\n\t\tt.lockHeld = lock\n\t} else {\n\t\tp.txns[txnID] = &partTxn{state: state, lockHeld: lock, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t}\n}\n\n// startQuerying 安排周期性决议询问。PREPARED 后参与者只能等——\n// 没有协调者（或持决议的同伴）答复前，锁一直持有，绝不中止。\nfunc (p *Participant) startQuerying(txnID string) {\n\tif p.querying[txnID] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tp.querying[txnID] = true\n\tp.ctx.Timer(TimerQuery, txnID, p.timings.Query)\n}\n\n// onDecisionRequest 处理同伴询问：只有自己处于确定状态时才能答复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onDecisionRequest(m Message) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\tif t == nil {\n\t\t// 自己没有任何记录 => 从未投过赞成票，事务中止是安全的。\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tswitch t.state {\n\tcase StateCommitted:\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionCommit, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tcase StateAborted:\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionAbort, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: m.From})\n\tcase StatePrepared:\n\t\t// 同样在等决议：无法帮助对方，保持沉默（对方继续阻塞）。\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.query.peererWait\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t}\n}\n\n// onPeerDecision 处理终止协议答复。\nfunc (p *Participant) onPeerDecision(m Message, commit bool) {\n\tt := p.txns[m.TxnID]\n\t// 只有处于 PREPARED 的询问者才需要按答复行动。\n\tif t == nil || t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif commit {\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartCommitted, StateCommitted, false)\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.commit.fromPeer\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t\t// 同伴决议也视为终态；协调者恢复后通过重发 PREPARE 或 ACK 交换收敛。\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\t} else {\n\t\tp.writeTerminal(m.TxnID, recPartAborted, StateAborted, false)\n\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.abort.fromPeer\", m.TxnID, map[string]any{\"from\": m.From})\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgAck, TxnID: m.TxnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\t}\n\tdelete(p.querying, m.TxnID)\n}\n\n// OnTimer 处理询问定时器：向协调者与所有同伴发 DECISION_REQUEST。\nfunc (p *Participant) OnTimer(kind, txnID string) {\n\tif kind != TimerQuery {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tt := p.txns[txnID]\n\tif t == nil || t.state != StatePrepared {\n\t\tdelete(p.querying, txnID)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 仍处于 PREPARED：继续等，继续问。这不是超时回滚。\n\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.query.tick\", txnID, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"waitedTicks\": p.ctx.Now() - t.sinceTick, \"lockHeld\": true,\n\t})\n\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionRequest, TxnID: txnID, From: p.id, To: p.coordID})\n\tfor _, peer := range p.peers {\n\t\tp.ctx.Send(Message{Type: MsgDecisionRequest, TxnID: txnID, From: p.id, To: peer})\n\t}\n\tp.ctx.Timer(TimerQuery, txnID, p.timings.Query)\n}\n\n// Recover 重放 WAL；PREPARED 事务恢复后重新持锁并继续等待决议。\nfunc (p *Participant) Recover() {\n\tp.txns = map[string]*partTxn{}\n\terr := p.log.Replay(func(r wal.Record) error {\n\t\tvar d txnRec\n\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(r.Data, &d); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch r.Type {\n\t\tcase recPartPrepared:\n\t\t\t// 可能后面还有同事务的终态记录，先标记，后续覆盖。\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StatePrepared, lockHeld: true, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\tcase recPartCommitted:\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StateCommitted, lockHeld: false, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\tcase recPartAborted:\n\t\t\tp.txns[d.TxnID] = &partTxn{state: StateAborted, lockHeld: false, sinceTick: p.ctx.Now()}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tfor id, t := range p.txns {\n\t\tif t.state == StatePrepared {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.recover.prepared\", id, map[string]any{\"lockHeld\": true})\n\t\t\tp.startQuerying(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tp.ctx.Event(\"participant.recover.terminal\", id, map[string]any{\"state\": t.state})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Snapshot       `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tVerdict    string            `json:\"verdict\"`    // committed | aborted | blocked\n\tCommitted  []string          `json:\"committed\"`  // 最终状态 committed 的参与者\n\tAborted    []string          `json:\"aborted\"`    // 最终状态 aborted 的参与者\n\tPrepared   []string          `json:\"prepared\"`   // 窗口结束仍 prepared（持锁）的参与者\n\tUnknown    []string          `json:\"unknown\"`    // 无任何记录的参与者\n\tPartialCommit bool           `json:\"partialCommit\"` // true=出现部分参与者提交（协议被破坏）\n\tBlockedEvidence *BlockedEvidence `json:\"blockedEvidence,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// BlockedEvidence 展示“真的阻塞了”，而不是伪称可用。\ntype BlockedEvidence struct {\n\tCoordinatorAvailable bool              `json:\"coordinatorAvailable\"`\n\tParticipants         []BlockedPart     `json:\"participants\"`\n\t// 协调者磁盘上是否已有决议（有决议但未传达 vs 决议根本未形成）。\n\tCoordinatorDecision string `json:\"coordinatorDecision\"` // unknown | commit | abort\n\tQueryTicks          []QueryTickEvidence `json:\"queryTicks,omitempty\"`\n\tExplanation         string `json:\"explanation\"`\n}\n\n// BlockedPart 是单个被阻塞参与者的持锁证据。\ntype BlockedPart struct {\n\tNodeID       string `json:\"nodeId\"`\n\tState        string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLockHeld     bool   `json:\"lockHeld\"`\n\tPreparedTick int64  `json:\"preparedTick\"`\n\tWaitedTicks  int64  `json:\"waitedTicks\"`\n\tLastQueryTick int64 `json:\"lastQueryTick\"`\n\tQueriesSent   int   `json:\"queriesSent\"`\n}\n\n// QueryTickEvidence 记录一次询问（向协调者+同伴）的时刻。\ntype QueryTickEvidence struct {\n\tTick int64  `json:\"tick\"`\n\tFrom string `json:\"from\"`\n}\n\n// Report 是一次运行的完整 JSON 输出。\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario        string                 `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed            int64                  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tMaxTick         int64                  `json:\"maxTick\"`\n\tDataDir         string                 `json:\"dataDir\"`\n\tNetwork         NetworkCfg             `json:\"network\"`\n\tTimings         twopc.Timings          `json:\"timings\"`\n\tNodeSnapshots   []twopc.NodeSnapshot   `json:\"nodeSnapshots\"`\n\tOutcomes        []TxnOutcome           `json:\"outcomes\"`\n\tVerdict         string                 `json:\"verdict\"` // all-consistent | partial-commit-detected\n\tPartialCommits  []string               `json:\"partialCommits,omitempty\"`\n\tProtocolViolations []TraceEntry        `json:\"protocolViolations,omitempty\"`\n\tCrashes         []CrashSummary         `json:\"crashes\"`\n\tTrace           []TraceEntry           `json:\"trace\"`\n}\n\n// CrashSummary 汇总崩溃/重启是否按计划发生（验证注入生效）。\ntype CrashSummary struct {\n\tNodeID      string `json:\"nodeId\"`\n\tTrigger     string `json:\"trigger\"`\n\tCrashed     bool   `json:\"crashed\"`\n\tRestartTick int64  `json:\"restartTick,omitempty\"`\n\tRestarted   bool   `json:\"restarted\"`\n}\n\n// Report 生成最终报告。\nfunc (r *Runner) Report() *Report {\n\t// 1) 节点快照：存活用内存视图；宕机用磁盘 WAL 重放重建。\n\tsnaps := make([]twopc.NodeSnapshot, 0, len(r.nodes))\n\tnodeStates := map[string]map[string]string{}\n\tnodeLocks := map[string]map[string]bool{}\n\tnodeIDs := append([]string{CoordinatorID}, ParticipantIDs()...)\n\tfor _, id := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tvar snap twopc.NodeSnapshot\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.snapshotFromWAL(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.nodes[id].Snapshot()\n\t\t}\n\t\tsnaps = append(snaps, snap)\n\t\tstates := map[string]string{}\n\t\tlocks := map[string]bool{}\n\t\tfor txn, v := range snap.TxnStates {\n\t\t\tstates[txn] = v.State\n\t\t\tlocks[txn] = v.LockHeld\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeStates[id] = states\n\t\tnodeLocks[id] = locks\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) PREPARED 首次时刻（来自追踪事件，兼顾存活与已崩溃节点）。\n\tfirstPrepared := map[string]map[string]int64{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.prepared.fsynced\" {\n\t\t\tif firstPrepared[e.Node] == nil {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node] = map[string]int64{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := firstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) 询问证据。\n\tqueryTicks := []QueryTickEvidence{}\n\tlastQuery := map[string]int64{}\n\tqueryCount := map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.query.tick\" {\n\t\t\tqueryTicks = append(queryTicks, QueryTickEvidence{Tick: e.Tick, From: e.Node})\n\t\t\tlastQuery[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\tqueryCount[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) 逐事务裁决。\n\toutcomes := make([]TxnOutcome, 0, len(r.sc.Transactions))\n\tvar partials []string\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\to := r.judgeTxn(t.ID, nodeStates, nodeLocks, firstPrepared, lastQuery, queryCount)\n\t\tif o.PartialCommit {\n\t\t\tpartials = append(partials, t.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\toutcomes = append(outcomes, o)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) 协议违规事件。\n\tvar violations []TraceEntry\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.protocolViolation\" {\n\t\t\tviolations = append(violations, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tverdict := \"all-consistent\"\n\tif len(partials) > 0 {\n\t\tverdict = \"partial-commit-detected\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn &Report{\n\t\tScenario:           r.sc.Name,\n\t\tSeed:               r.sc.Seed,\n\t\tMaxTick:            r.sc.MaxTick,\n\t\tDataDir:            r.sc.DataDir,\n\t\tNetwork:            r.sc.Network,\n\t\tTimings:            r.sc.Timings,\n\t\tNodeSnapshots:      snaps,\n\t\tOutcomes:           outcomes,\n\t\tVerdict:            verdict,\n\t\tPartialCommits:     partials,\n\t\tProtocolViolations: violations,\n\t\tCrashes:            r.crashSummary(),\n\t\tTrace:              r.trace,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) judgeTxn(txnID string,\n\tnodeStates, nodeLocks map[string]map[string]bool,\n\t_ map[string]map[string]int64, _ map[string]int64, _ map[string]int,\n) TxnOutcome {\n\t_ = nodeLocks\n\to := TxnOutcome{TxnID: txnID}\n\tfor _, p := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tst := nodeStates[p][txnID]\n\t\tif st == \"\" {\n\t\t\tst = twopc.StateUnknown\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch st {\n\t\tcase twopc.StateCommitted:\n\t\t\to.Committed = append(o.Committed, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StateAborted:\n\t\t\to.Aborted = append(o.Aborted, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StatePrepared:\n\t\t\to.Prepared = append(o.Prepared, p)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\to.Unknown = append(o.Unknown, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 部分提交：有人 committed 且还有人 aborted/unknown（prepared 不算分叉——\n\t// 决议为提交时 prepared 只是尚未收到第二阶段，仍可收敛）。\n\tif len(o.Committed) > 0 && (len(o.Aborted) > 0 || len(o.Unknown) > 0) {\n\t\to.PartialCommit = true\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase len(o.Committed) == 3:\n\t\to.Verdict = twopc.StateCommitted\n\tcase len(o.Committed) > 0 && len(o.Committed)+len(o.Prepared) == 3:\n\t\t// 决议已提交，但部分参与者还停在 prepared（协调者可能恰好又宕机）。\n\t\to.Verdict = \"blocked\"\n\tcase len(o.Committed) > 0:\n\t\t// committed 与 aborted/unknown 并存 => 部分提交。\n\t\to.Verdict = \"partial-commit\"\n\tcase len(o.Prepared) > 0:\n\t\to.Verdict = \"blocked\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\to.Verdict = twopc.StateAborted\n\t}\n\n\tif o.Verdict == \"blocked\" {\n\t\to.BlockedEvidence = r.blockedEvidence(txnID, nodeStates, firstPreparedOf(r.trace, txnID))\n\t}\n\treturn o\n}\n\n// firstPreparedOf 从 trace 提取某事务各参与者首次 PREPARED 时刻。\nfunc firstPreparedOf(trace []TraceEntry, txnID string) map[string]int64 {\n\tout := map[string]int64{}\n\tfor _, e := range trace {\n\t\tif e.TxnID == txnID && e.Kind == \"participant.prepared.fsynced\" {\n\t\t\tif _, ok := out[e.Node]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\tout[e.Node] = e.Tick\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) blockedEvidence(txnID string, nodeStates map[string]map[string]string, prepTick map[string]int64) *BlockedEvidence {\n\tev := &BlockedEvidence{\n\t\tCoordinatorAvailable: !r.down[CoordinatorID],\n\t}\n\tcoordState := nodeStates[CoordinatorID][txnID]\n\tswitch coordState {\n\tcase twopc.StateCommitting:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"commit\"\n\tcase twopc.StateAborting:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"abort\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"unknown\"\n\t}\n\n\tlastQuery := map[string]int64{}\n\tqueries := map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.TxnID == txnID && e.Kind == \"participant.query.tick\" {\n\t\t\tlastQuery[e.Node] = e.Tick\n\t\t\tqueries[e.Node]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tids := append([]string{}, ParticipantIDs()...)\n\tsort.Strings(ids)\n\tfor _, p := range ids {\n\t\tst := nodeStates[p][txnID]\n\t\tif st != twopc.StatePrepared {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tpt := prepTick[p]\n\t\tev.Participants = append(ev.Participants, BlockedPart{\n\t\t\tNodeID:        p,\n\t\t\tState:         st,\n\t\t\tLockHeld:      true,\n\t\t\tPreparedTick:  pt,\n\t\t\tWaitedTicks:   r.sc.MaxTick - pt,\n\t\t\tLastQueryTick: lastQuery[p],\n\t\t\tQueriesSent:   queries[p],\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// 收集本事务询问时刻（限量，避免报告过大）。\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.TxnID == txnID && e.Kind == \"participant.query.tick\" && len(ev.QueryTicks) < 30 {\n\t\t\tev.QueryTicks = append(ev.QueryTicks, QueryTickEvidence{Tick: e.Tick, From: e.Node})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase !ev.CoordinatorAvailable && ev.CoordinatorDecision == \"unknown\":\n\t\tev.Explanation = \"协调者在形成决议前不可用：已投赞成票的参与者持有 PREPARED 记录与资源锁，\" +\n\t\t\t\"既不能提交也不敢中止（同伴同样无决议），只能周期性询问并阻塞。这是 2PC 的固有阻塞点。\"\n\tcase !ev.CoordinatorAvailable && ev.CoordinatorDecision == \"commit\":\n\t\tev.Explanation = \"协调者在 fsync COMMIT 后、通知完成前不可用：决议本身已是提交且不可撤销，\" +\n\t\t\t\"未收到 GLOBAL_COMMIT 的参与者持锁阻塞，直到协调者（或已提交同伴）恢复告知决议。\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\tev.Explanation = \"参与者处于 PREPARED 且在整个观察窗口内未获得任何权威决议；持锁等待中（阻塞）。\"\n\t}\n\treturn ev\n}\n\n// snapshotFromWAL 重放宕机节点的磁盘日志，重建其持久状态（无易失状态）。\nfunc (r *Runner) snapshotFromWAL(id string) twopc.NodeSnapshot {\n\tsnap := twopc.NodeSnapshot{ID: id, TxnStates: map[string]twopc.TxnView{}}\n\tpath := r.walh[id].Path()\n\t// 通过临时 WAL 只读重放（r.walh[id] 仍保持打开的追加句柄，这里独立打开读取）。\n\tw, err := wal.Open(\"\", \"\")\n\t_ = w\n\t_ = err\n\t// 直接用已打开句柄的 Replay（只读，不影响偏移）。\n\t_ = r.walh[id].Replay(func(rec wal.Record) error {\n\t\tvar d struct {\n\t\t\tTxnID string `json:\"txnId\"`\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(rec.Data, &d); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch rec.Type {\n\t\tcase \"COORD_START\":\n\t\t\tsnap.TxnStates[d.TxnID] = twopc.TxnView{State: twopc.StatePreparing}\n\t\tcase \"COORD_COMMIT\", \"PART_COMMITTED\":\n\t\t\tlock := false\n\t\t\tst := twopc.StateCommitted\n\t\t\tif rec.Type == \"COORD_COMMIT\" {\n\t\t\t\tst = twopc.StateCommitting\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsnap.TxnStates[d.TxnID] = `json:\"from\"`\n}\n\n// Report 是一次运行的完整 JSON 输出。\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario        string                 `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed            int64 `json:\"network\"`\n\tTimings         twopc.Timings          `json:\"timings\"`\n\tNodeSnapshots   []twopc.NodeSnapshot   `json:\"nodeSnapshots\"`\n\tOutcomes        []TxnOutcome `json:\"partialCommits,omitempty\"`\n\tProtocolViolations []TraceEntry        `json:\"protocolViolations,omitempty\"`\n\tCrashes         []CrashSummary         `json:\"crashes\"`\n\tTrace           []TraceEntry           `json:\"trace\"`\n}\n\n// CrashSummary 汇总崩溃/重启是否按计划发生（验证注入生效）。\ntype CrashSummary struct {\n\tNodeID      string `json:\"nodeId\"`\n\tTrigger     string Report() *Report {\n\t// 1) 节点快照：存活用内存视图；宕机用磁盘 WAL 重放重建。\n\tsnaps := make([]twopc.NodeSnapshot, 0, len(r.nodes))\n\tnodeStates := map[string]map[string]string{}\n\tnodeLocks := map[string]map[string]bool{}\n\tnodeIDs := append([]string{CoordinatorID}, ParticipantIDs()...)\n\tfor _, id := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tvar snap twopc.NodeSnapshot\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.snapshotFromWAL(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.nodes[id].Snapshot()\n\t\t}\n\t\tsnaps = append(snaps, snap)\n\t\tstates := map[string]string{}\n\t\tlocks := map[string]bool{}\n\t\tfor txn, v := range snap.TxnStates {\n\t\t\tstates[txn] = v.State\n\t\t\tlocks[txn] = v.LockHeld\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeStates[id] = states\n\t\tnodeLocks[id] = locks\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) PREPARED 首次时刻（来自追踪事件，兼顾存活与已崩溃节点）。\n\tfirstPrepared := map[string]map[string]int64{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.prepared.fsynced\" {\n\t\t\tif firstPrepared[e.Node] == nil {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node] = map[string]int64{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := firstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) 询问证据。\n\tqueryTicks := []QueryTickEvidence{}\n\tlastQuery := map[string]int64{}\n\tqueryCount := map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.query.tick\" {\n\t\t\tqueryTicks = append(queryTicks, QueryTickEvidence{Tick: e.Tick, From: e.Node})\n\t\t\tlastQuery[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\tqueryCount[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) 逐事务裁决。\n\toutcomes := make([]TxnOutcome, 0, len(r.sc.Transactions))\n\tvar partials []string\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\to := r.judgeTxn(t.ID, nodeStates, nodeLocks, firstPrepared, lastQuery, queryCount)\n\t\tif o.PartialCommit {\n\t\t\tpartials = append(partials, t.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\toutcomes = append(outcomes, o)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) 协议违规事件。\n\tvar violations []TraceEntry\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.protocolViolation\" {\n\t\t\tviolations = append(violations, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tverdict := \"all-consistent\"\n\tif len(partials) > 0 {\n\t\tverdict = \"partial-commit-detected\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn &Report{\n\t\tScenario:           r.sc.Name,\n\t\tSeed:               r.sc.Seed,\n\t\tMaxTick:            r.sc.MaxTick,\n\t\tDataDir:            r.sc.DataDir,\n\t\tNetwork:            r.sc.Network,\n\t\tTimings:            r.sc.Timings,\n\t\tNodeSnapshots:      snaps,\n\t\tOutcomes:           outcomes,\n\t\tVerdict:            verdict,\n\t\tPartialCommits:     partials,\n\t\tProtocolViolations: violations,\n\t\tCrashes:            r.crashSummary(),\n\t\tTrace:              r.trace,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) judgeTxn(txnID string,\n\tnodeStates, nodeLocks map[string]map[string]bool,\n\t_ map[string]map[string]int64, _ map[string]int64, _ map[string]int,\n) TxnOutcome {\n\t_ = nodeLocks\n\to := TxnOutcome{TxnID: txnID}\n\tfor _, p := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tst := nodeStates[p][txnID]\n\t\tif st == \"\" {\n\t\t\tst = twopc.StateUnknown\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch st {\n\t\tcase twopc.StateCommitted:\n\t\t\to.Committed = append(o.Committed, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StateAborted:\n\t\t\to.Aborted = append(o.Aborted, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StatePrepared:\n\t\t\to.Prepared = len(o.Committed) > 0 && (len(o.Aborted) > 0 || len(o.Unknown) > 0) {\n\t\to.PartialCommit = true\n\t}\n\n\tswitch {\n\tcase len(o.Committed) == 3:\n\t\to.Verdict = twopc.StateCommitted\n\tcase Report() *Report {\n\t// 1) 节点快照：存活用内存视图；宕机用磁盘 WAL 重放重建。\n\tsnaps := make([]twopc.NodeSnapshot, 0, len(r.nodes))\n\tnodeStates := map[string]map[string]string{}\n\tnodeLocks := r.snapshotFromWAL(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.nodes[id].Snapshot()\n\t\t}\n\t\tsnaps = append(snaps, snap)\n\t\tstates := map[string]string{}\n\t\tlocks := map[string]bool{}\n\t\tfor txn, v := {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node] = map[string]int64{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif _, ok := firstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID]; !ok {\n\t\t\t\tfirstPrepared[e.Node][e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) {\n\t\t\tqueryTicks = append(queryTicks, QueryTickEvidence{Tick: e.Tick, From: e.Node})\n\t\t\tlastQuery[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID] = e.Tick\n\t\t\tqueryCount[e.Node+\"/\"+e.TxnID]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 4) 逐事务裁决。\n\toutcomes := make([]TxnOutcome, 0, len(r.sc.Transactions))\n\tvar partials []string\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\to := r.judgeTxn(t.ID, nodeStates, nodeLocks, firstPrepared, lastQuery, queryCount)\n\t\tif o.PartialCommit {\n\t\t\tpartials = append(partials, t.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\toutcomes = append(outcomes, o)\n\t}\n\n\t// 5) 协议违规事件。\n\tvar violations []TraceEntry\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.protocolViolation\" {\n\t\t\tviolations = append(violations, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tverdict := \"all-consistent\"\n\tif len(partials) > 0 {\n\t\tverdict r.sc.DataDir,\n\t\tNetwork:            r.sc.Network,\n\t\tTimings:            r.sc.Timings,\n\t\tNodeSnapshots:      snaps,\n\t\tOutcomes:           outcomes,\n\t\tVerdict:            verdict,\n\t\tPartialCommits:     partials,\n\t\tProtocolViolations: violations,\n\t\tCrashes:            r.crashSummary(),\n\t\tTrace:              r.trace,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) judgeTxn(txnID string,\n\tnodeStates, nodeLocks map[string]map[string]bool,\n\t_ map[string]map[string]int64, _ map[string]int64, _ map[string]int,\n) TxnOutcome {\n\t_ = nodeLocks\n\to := TxnOutcome{TxnID: txnID}\n\tfor _, p := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tst := nodeStates[p][txnID]\n\t\tif st == \"\" {\n\t\t\tst = twopc.StateUnknown\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch st {\n\t\tcase twopc.StateCommitted:\n\t\t\to.Committed = append(o.Committed, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StateAborted:\n\t\t\to.Aborted = append(o.Aborted, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StatePrepared:\n\t\t\to.Prepared =   bool // 规则确实触发过崩溃\n\trestarted bool // 规则配置的重启确实发生过\n}\n\n// runnerCtx 把节点协议代码与调度器/网络/故障注入连接起来。\ntype runnerCtx struct {\n\towner    string\n\tr        *Runner\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Now() int64 { return c.r.sched.Now() }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Send(m twopc.Message) { c.r.netSend(c.owner, m) }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Timer(kind, txnID string, delay int64) {\n\towner := c.owner\n\tc.r.sched.Schedule(owner, \"timer:\"+kind, delay, func() {\n\t\tif !c.r.isUp(owner) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.r.nodes[owner].OnTimer(kind, txnID)\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Event(kind, txnID string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tc.r.trace = append(c.r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick: c.r.sched.Now(), Node: c.owner, Kind: kind, TxnID: txnID, Detail: detail,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Hook(point, txnID string) bool {\n\treturn c.r.hookFired(c.owner, point, txnID)\n}\n\n// Runner 是一次模拟运行。\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc    Scenario\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\n\tnodes map[string]map[string]int64\n}\n\n// New 构造一次运行（打开 WAL、创建节点，但不启动任何事件）。\nfunc New(sc Scenario) (*Runner, error) {\n\tsc = withDefaults(sc)\n\tif err := validate(sc); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdir := sc.DataDir\n\tif dir == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tdir, err = os.MkdirTemp(\"\", \"twopc-\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tsc.DataDir = dir\n\t}\n\tfresh := true\n\tif sc.Fresh != nil {\n\t\tfresh = *sc.Fresh\n\t}\n\tif fresh {\n\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(dir); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t} else if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tr := &Runner{\n\t\tsc:                sc,\n\t\tsched:             sim.New(sc.Seed),\n\t\tnodes:             map[string]twopc.Node{},\n\t\tcoords:            map[string]*twopc.Coordinator{},\n\t\tparts:             map[string]*twopc.Participant{},\n\t\twalh:              map[string]*wal.WAL{},\n\t\tctxs:              map[string]*runnerCtx{},\n\t\tdown:              map[string]bool{},\n\t\tcrashes:           map[string]*crashState{},\n\t\tatTickSet:         map[string]bool{},\n\t\tfirstPreparedTick: map[string]map[string]int64{},\n\t}\n\n\t// 协调者。\n\tcw, err := wal.Open(dir, CoordinatorID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tcoord := twopc.NewCoordinator(CoordinatorID, cw, sc.Timings)\n\tcoord.SetTopology(ParticipantIDs())\n\tr.walh[CoordinatorID] = cw\n\tr.coords[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\tr.nodes[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\n\t// 参与者。\n\tpeersOf := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tvar peers []string\n\t\tfor _, other := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\t\tif other != id {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, other)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeersOf[id] = peers\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tpw, err := wal.Open(dir, id)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar voteNo []string\n\t\tfor _, t := range sc.Transactions {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range t.VoteNo {\n\t\t\t\tif v == id {\n\t\t\t\t\tvoteNo = append(voteNo, t.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tp := twopc.NewParticipant(id, CoordinatorID, peersOf[id], sc.Timings, pw, voteNo)\n\t\tr.walh[id] = pw\n\t\tr.parts[id] = p\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = p\n\t}\n\n\t// 每个节点一个绑定 owner 的上下文。\n\tfor id, n := range r.nodes {\n\t\tctx := &runnerCtx{owner: id, r: r}\n\t\tr.ctxs[id] = ctx\n\t\tswitch v := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *twopc.Coordinator:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\tcase *twopc.Participant:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 崩溃规则。\n\tfor i := range sc.Crashes {\n\t\tcr := sc.Crashes[i]\n\t\tkey := {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"crashAtTick\", cs.rule.AtTick, func() {\n\t\t\tr.crashByRule(cs, \"atTick:\"+itoa(cs.rule.AtTick))\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tr.sched.Run(r.sc.MaxTick)\n\n\t// 记录观察窗口结束时各节点存活情况（证据）。\n\tfor id := range r.nodes {\n\t\tstate := \"up\"\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tstate = \"down\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sc.MaxTick, Node: id, Kind: \"endofwindow.\" + state,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) sortedCrashStates() []*crashState {\n\tvar out []*crashState\n\tfor _, cs := range r.crashes {\n\t\tout = append(out, cs)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].rule.AtTick != out[j].rule.AtTick {\n\t\t\treturn trigger)\n\tif cs.rule.RestartTick > 0 {\n\t\tr.scheduleRestartByRule(cs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) crashNode(id, where string) {\n\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.down[id] = true\n\t// 崩溃 = 易失状态（待处理定时器、发到该节点的在途消息）全部丢失。\n\tn := r.sched.CancelOwner(id)\n\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick:   r.sched.Now(),\n\t\tNode:   id,\n\t\tKind:   \"node.crash\",\n\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"trigger\": where, \"cancelledPendingEvents\": n},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleRestart(id string, at int64) {\n\tdelay := at - r.sched.Now()\n\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"restart\", delay, func() {\n\t\tif !r.down[id] {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.down[id] = false\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sched.Now(), Node: id, Kind: \"node.restart\",\n\t\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"wal\": filepath.Base(r.walh[id].Path())},\n\t\t})\n\t\t// 重放持久日志，恢复协议状态。\n\t\tr.nodes[id].Recover()\n\t})\n}\n\n// hookFired 易失状态（待处理定时器、发到该节点的在途消息）全部丢失。\n\tn := r.sched.CancelOwner(id)\n\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick:   r.sched.Now(),\n\t\tNode:   id,\n\t\tKind:   \"node.crash\",\n\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"trigger\": where, \"cancelledPendingEvents\": n},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleRestartByRule(cs *crashState) {\n\tid := cs.rule.NodeID\n\tat := cs.rule.RestartTick\n\tdelay := at - r.sched.Now()\n\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"restart\", delay, func() {\n\t\tif !r.down[id] {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.down[id] = false\n\t\tcs.restarted = true\n\t\tr.trace = 重放持久日志，恢复协议状态。\n\t\tr.nodes[id].Recover()\n\t})\n}\n\n// hookFired 在节点协议钩子处被调用：匹配规则则让节点崩溃。\nfunc (r *Runner) hookFired(owner, point, txnID string) bool {\n\tfired := false\n\tfor _, cs := range err != nil {\n\t\tfatal(fmt.Errorf(\"解析场景失败: %w\", err))\n\t}\n\n\tr, err := runner.New(sc)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfatal(err)\n\t}\n\tr.Run()\n\trep := r.Report()\n\tfor _, n := range rep.NodeSnapshots {\n\t\t_ = n\n\t}\n\n\tvar out io.Writer = os.Stdout\n\tif *outPath != \"\" {\n\t\tf, err := os.Create(*outPath)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tfatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tdefer f.Close()\n\t\tout = f\n\t}\n\tenc := json.NewEncoder(out)\n\tenc.SetIndent(\"\", \"  \")\n\tif err := enc.Encode(rep); txnID, c.timings.Resend)\n}","originalFile":"package twopc\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/wal\"\n)\n\n// 协调者 WAL 记录类型。\nconst (\n\trecCoordStart  = \"COORD_START\"  // {txnId, participants}\n\trecCoordCommit = \"COORD_COMMIT\" // {txnId}\n\trecCoordAbort  = \"COORD_ABORT\"  // {txnId}\n)\n\n// Timings 控制协议定时器（tick 数），便于按场景调大观察窗口。\ntype Timings struct {\n\tVoteTimeout int64 `json:\"voteTimeout\"` // 收齐投票截止时间\n\tResend      int64 `json:\"resend\"`      // 第二阶段决议重发间隔\n\tQuery       int64 `json:\"query\"`       // 参与者询问间隔\n}\n\n// DefaultTimings 为默认定时器配置。\nfunc DefaultTimings() Timings {\n\treturn Timings{VoteTimeout: 40, Resend: 15, Query: 10}\n}\n\ntype startRec struct {\n\tTxnID        string   `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tParticipants []string `json:\"participants\"`\n}\n\ntype txnRec struct {\n\tTxnID string `json:\"txnId\"`\n}\n\ntype coordTxn struct {\n\tid         string\n\tstate      string // preparing | committing | aborting | committed | aborted\n\tparts      []string\n\tyesVotes   map[string]bool\n\tacked      map[string]bool\n\tgotVotes   map[string]bool\n\tsinceTick  int64\n\tcommitTick int64 // 决议形成时刻（阻塞时长统计从这里无意义，仅记录）\n}\n\n// Coordinator 是 2PC 协调者。\ntype Coordinator struct {\n\tid       string\n\ttimings  Timings\n\tlog      *wal.WAL\n\tctx      Context\n\ttxns {"type":"last-prompt","lastPrompt":"从空目录开发“两阶段提交恢复”纯后端项目。用Go实现确定性离散事件模拟器与JSON运行接口，节点在单进程内模拟，网络可丢包、重复和乱序，禁止依赖真实集群。实现协调者和3个参与者的持久化2PC，准备成功后参与者不得自行超时回滚，明确协调者不可用时可能阻塞。验收：在每个协议阶段崩溃重启，验证无部分提交，并用证据展示阻塞而非伪称始终可用。交付源码、README、请求样例与自动化测试；实际运行并如实记录命…","leafUuid":"9894b86d-b4ec-4b47-8578-960836de4fff","sessionId":"a5b42795-2297-4074-82c7-ae2988605914"}

逐事件完全可复现；\n//   - 不依赖 wall clock、goroutine 时序或真实网络。\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n)\n\n// Event 是调度器内部的一个事件。\ntype Event struct {\n\ttick  int64\n\tseq {\n\treturn &Scheduler{rng: rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed))}\n}\n\n// Now 返回当前虚拟时刻。\nfunc (s *Scheduler) Now() int64 { return s.now }\n\n// Rng 返回内部确定性随机源（网络层使用，业务代码不应自行随机）。\nfunc (s *Scheduler) Rng() *rand.Rand { return s.rng }\n\n// Schedule 在 now+delay 触发 fn。owner 为归属节点 ID，kind 仅用于追踪。\nfunc (s *Scheduler) Schedule(owner, kind string, delay int64, fn func()) {\n\tif delay < 0 {\n\t\tdelay = 每个事件执行前先把时钟跳到事件时刻。\nfunc (s *Scheduler) Run(maxTick int64) {\n\tfor len(s.events) > 0 {\n\t\te := heap.Pop(&s.events).(*Event)\n\t\tif e.tick > maxTick {\n\t\t\t// eventHeap []*Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\n\n// 同一时刻按入队序号排序，保证确定性。\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].tick != h[j].tick {\n\t\treturn h[i].tick < h[j].tick\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\n\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any) { *h = append(*h, x.(*Event)) }\n\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\te := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn n.MinDelay\n\tdelay := n.MinDelay\n\tif span > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += r.sched.Rng().Int63n(span + 1)\n\t}\n\t// 乱序：给一部分消息附加较长延迟，使其晚于后发出的消息到达。\n\tif n.ReorderRate > 0 && r.sched.Rng().Float64() < n.ReorderRate && n.ReorderDelay > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += n.ReorderDelay\n\t}\n\tto := m.To\n\tkind := \"message\"\n\tr.sched.Schedule(to, kind, delay, func() {\n\t\tif r.down[to] {\n\t\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\t\tTick:  r.sched.Now(),\n\t\t\t\tNode:  to,\n\t\t\t\tKind:  \"net.lostNodeDown\",\n\t\t\t\tTxnID: m.TxnID,\n\t\t\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"type\": m.Type, \"from\": m.From},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick:  r.sched.Now(),\n\t\t\tNode:  to,\n\t\t\tKind:  \"net.deliver\",\n\t\t\tTxnID: m.TxnID,\n\t\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"type\": m.Type, \"from\": m.From, \"duplicate\": duplicate},\n\t\t})\n\t\tr.nodes[to].OnMessage(m)\n\t})\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":57,"oldLines":7,"newStart":57,"newLines":7,"lines":["   }","   to := m.To","   kind := \"message\"","-  r.sched.Schedule(to, kind, delay, func() {","+  r.sched.ScheduleFrom(to, m.From, kind, delay, func() {","     if r.down[to] {","       r.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{","         Tick:  r.sched.Now(),"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e92968b5-c340-4856-b9bd-aec210e9a850","session_id":"a5b42795-2297-4074-82c7-ae2988605914","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/a","sessionId":"a5b42795-2297-4074-82c7-ae2988605914","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp27-a","slug":"zazzy-leaping-sifakis"}

}\n\n// TraceEntry 是一条协议追踪事件（报告证据）。\ntype TraceEntry struct {\n\tTick   int64             `json:\"tick\"`\n\tNode   string            `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind   string            `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTxnID  string            `json:\"txnId,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail map[string]any    `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype crashState struct {\n\trule      CrashRule\n\thits      int\n\tdone      bool\n\tcrashed   bool // 规则确实触发过崩溃\n\trestarted bool // 规则配置的重启确实发生过\n}\n\n// runnerCtx 把节点协议代码与调度器/网络/故障注入连接起来。\ntype runnerCtx struct {\n\towner    string\n\tr        *Runner\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Now() int64 { return c.r.sched.Now() }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Send(m twopc.Message) { c.r.netSend(c.owner, m) }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Timer(kind, txnID string, delay int64) {\n\towner := c.owner\n\tc.r.sched.Schedule(owner, \"timer:\"+kind, delay, func() {\n\t\tif !c.r.isUp(owner) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.r.nodes[owner].OnTimer(kind, txnID)\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Event(kind, txnID string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tc.r.trace = append(c.r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick: c.r.sched.Now(), Node: c.owner, Kind: kind, TxnID: txnID, Detail: detail,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Hook(point, txnID string) bool {\n\treturn c.r.hookFired(c.owner, point, txnID)\n}\n\n// Runner 是一次模拟运行。\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc    Scenario\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\n\tnodes map[string]twopc.Node\n\tcoords map[string]*twopc.Coordinator\n\tparts  map[string]*twopc.Participant\n\twalh   map[string]*wal.WAL\n\tctxs   map[string]*runnerCtx\n\n\tdown      map[string]bool\n\tcrashes   map[string]*crashState\n\n\ttrace []TraceEntry\n}\n\n// New 构造一次运行（打开 WAL、创建节点，但不启动任何事件）。\nfunc New(sc Scenario) (*Runner, error) {\n\tsc = withDefaults(sc)\n\tif err := validate(sc); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdir := sc.DataDir\n\tif dir == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tdir, err = os.MkdirTemp(\"\", \"twopc-\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tsc.DataDir = dir\n\t}\n\tfresh := true\n\tif sc.Fresh != nil {\n\t\tfresh = *sc.Fresh\n\t}\n\tif fresh {\n\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(dir); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, &Runner{\n\t\tsc:                sc,\n\t\tsched:             sim.New(sc.Seed),\n\t\tnodes:             map[string]twopc.Node{},\n\t\tcoords:            map[string]*twopc.Coordinator{},\n\t\tparts:             map[string]*twopc.Participant{},\n\t\twalh:              map[string]*wal.WAL{},\n\t\tctxs:              map[string]*runnerCtx{},\n\t\tdown:              map[string]bool{},\n\t\tcrashes:           map[string]*crashState{},\n\t}\n\n\t// 协调者。\n\tcw, err := wal.Open(dir, CoordinatorID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tcoord := twopc.NewCoordinator(CoordinatorID, cw, sc.Timings)\n\tcoord.SetTopology(ParticipantIDs())\n\tr.walh[CoordinatorID] = cw\n\tr.coords[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\tr.nodes[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\n\t// 参与者。\n\tpeersOf := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tvar peers []string\n\t\tfor _, other := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\t\tif other != id {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, other)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeersOf[id] = peers\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tpw, err := wal.Open(dir, id)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar voteNo []string\n\t\tfor _, t := range sc.Transactions {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range t.VoteNo {\n\t\t\t\tif v == id {\n\t\t\t\t\tvoteNo = append(voteNo, t.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tp := twopc.NewParticipant(id, CoordinatorID, peersOf[id], sc.Timings, pw, voteNo)\n\t\tr.walh[id] = pw\n\t\tr.parts[id] = p\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = p\n\t}\n\n\t// 每个节点一个绑定 owner 的上下文。\n\tfor id, n := range r.nodes {\n\t\tctx := &runnerCtx{owner: id, r: r}\n\t\tr.ctxs[id] = ctx\n\t\tswitch v := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *twopc.Coordinator:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\tcase *twopc.Participant:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 崩溃规则。\n\tfor i := range sc.Crashes {\n\t\tcr := sc.Crashes[i]\n\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d:%s:%s:%s:%d\", i, cr.NodeID, cr.Hook, cr.TxnID, cr.AtTick)\n\t\tr.crashes[key] = &crashState{rule: cr}\n\t}\n\treturn r, nil\n}\n\n// Run 执行模拟直到观察窗口结束。\nfunc (r *Runner) Run() {\n\t// Begin 事件。\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\tt := t\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"begin\", t.BeginTick, func() {\n\t\t\tif r.isUp(CoordinatorID) {\n\t\t\t\tr.coords[CoordinatorID].Begin(t.ID)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// atTick 崩溃事件（重启也在此规则内调度）。\n\tfor _, cs := range r.sortedCrashStates() {\n\t\tcs := cs\n\t\tif cs.rule.Hook != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"crashAtTick\", cs.rule.AtTick, func() {\n\t\t\tr.crashByRule(cs, \"atTick:\"+itoa(cs.rule.AtTick))\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tr.sched.Run(r.sc.MaxTick)\n\n\t// 记录观察窗口结束时各节点存活情况（证据）。\n\tfor id := range r.nodes {\n\t\tstate := \"up\"\n\t\tif {"parentUuid":"67b91f1f-a5a4-4ce4-85e9-b468e6f4a318","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_zoyrpr3dtktmf87sah8t5q68","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp27/a/internal/runner/runner_test.go","content":"package runner_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/runner\"\n)\n\nfunc cleanNet() runner.NetworkCfg {\n\treturn runner.NetworkCfg{MinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 3}\n}\n\nfunc base(t *testing.T, name string) runner.Scenario {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tdir := t.TempDir()\n\treturn runner.Scenario{\n\t\tName:    name,\n\t\tSeed:    1,\n\t\tMaxTick: 300,\n\t\tDataDir: filepath.Join(dir, \"data\"),\n\t\tFresh:   boolPtr(true),\n\t\tNetwork: cleanNet(),\n\t\tTimings: runner.TimingsForTest(),\n\t\tTransactions: []runner.TxnSpec{{ID: \"txn-A\", BeginTick: 5}},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc boolPtr(b bool) *bool { return &b }\n\nfunc run(t *testing.T, sc runner.Scenario) *runner.Report {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tr, err := runner.New(sc)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"New: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\tr.Run()\n\trep := r.Report()\n\tr.Close()\n\treturn rep\n}\n\n// 1) 干净网络下全员提交。\nfunc TestHappyPathCommitsAllThree(t *testing.T) {\n\trep := run(t, base(t, \"happy\"))\n\tif rep.Verdict != \"all-consistent\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"verdict=%s\", rep.Verdict)\n\t}\n\to := rep.Outcomes[0]\n\tif o.Verdict != \"committed\" || len(o.Committed) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"应全员提交: %+v\", o)\n\t}\n}\n\n// 2) 确定性：同种子两次运行 trace 完全一致。\nfunc TestDeterministic(t *testing.T) {\n\tmk := func() runner.Scenario {\n\t\tsc := base(t, \"det\")\n\t\tsc.Network = runner.NetworkCfg{\n\t\t\tLossRate: 0.2, DuplicateRate: 0.15, ReorderRate: 0.2,\n\t\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 4, ReorderDelay: 7,\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn sc\n\t}\n\ta := run(t, mk())\n\tb := run(t, mk())\n\tif len(a.Trace) != len(b.Trace) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace 长度不同: %d vs %d\", len(a.Trace), len(b.Trace))\n\t}\n\tfor i := range a.Trace {\n\t\tx, y := a.Trace[i], b.Trace[i]\n\t\tif x.Tick != y.Tick || x.Node != y.Node || x.Kind != y.Kind {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"trace 在 #%d 分歧: %+v vs %+v\", i, x, y)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// 3) 有损网络下仍能达成一致（重发机制）。\nfunc TestLossyNetworkConsensus(t *testing.T) {\n\tsc := base(t, \"lossy\")\n\tsc.Network = runner.NetworkCfg{\n\t\tLossRate: 0.3, DuplicateRate: 0.15, ReorderRate: 0.2,\n\t\tMinDelay: 1, MaxDelay: 4, ReorderDelay: 8,\n\t}\n\trep := run(t, sc)\n\to := rep.Outcomes[0]\n\tif o.Verdict != \"committed\" || len(o.Committed) != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"有损网络下应靠重发全员提交: verdict=%s committed=%v\", o.Verdict, o.Committed)\n\t}\n}\n\n// 4) 一张否决票 => 全员中止，无部分提交。\nfunc TestVoteNoAbortsAll(t *testing.T) {\n\tsc := base(t, \"voteno\")\n\tsc.Transactions[0].VoteNo = []string{\"participant-2\"}\n\trep := run(t, sc)\n\to := rep.Outcomes[0]\n\tif o.Verdict != \"aborted\" || len(o.Aborted) != 3 || len(o.Committed) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"应全员中止: %+v\", o)\n\t}\n}\n\n// 5..N) 每个协议阶段崩溃重启 => 无部分提交。\nfunc TestCrashMatrixNoPartialCommit(t *testing.T) {\n\ttype tc struct {\n\t\tname       string\n\t\tnode       string\n\t\thook       string\n\t\trestart    int64\n\t\twantVerdict string\n\t}\n\tcases := []tc{\n\t\t{\"coord-start\", \"coordinator\", \"coordinator.start.appended\", 80, \"committed\"},\n\t\t{\"coord-commit\", \"coordinator\", \"coordinator.commit.appended\", 120, \"committed\"},\n\t\t{\"coord-abort\", \"coordinator\", \"coordinator.abort.appended\", 100, \"aborted\"},\n\t\t{\"part-after-prepared\", \"participant-2\", \"participant.after.prepared\", 40, \"committed\"},\n\t\t{\"part-after-commit\", \"participant-3\", }\n\n// TraceEntry 是一条协议追踪事件（报告证据）。\ntype TraceEntry struct {\n\tTick   int64             `json:\"tick\"`\n\tNode   string            `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind   string            `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTxnID  string            `json:\"txnId,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail map[string]any    `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype crashState struct {\n\trule      CrashRule\n\thits      int\n\tdone      bool\n\tcrashed   bool // 规则确实触发过崩溃\n\trestarted bool // 规则配置的重启确实发生过\n}\n\n// runnerCtx 把节点协议代码与调度器/网络/故障注入连接起来。\ntype runnerCtx struct {\n\towner    string\n\tr        *Runner\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Now() int64 { return c.r.sched.Now() }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Send(m twopc.Message) { c.r.netSend(c.owner, m) }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Timer(kind, txnID string, delay int64) {\n\towner := c.owner\n\tc.r.sched.Schedule(owner, \"timer:\"+kind, delay, func() {\n\t\tif !c.r.isUp(owner) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.r.nodes[owner].OnTimer(kind, txnID)\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Event(kind, txnID string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tc.r.trace = append(c.r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick: c.r.sched.Now(), Node: c.owner, Kind: kind, TxnID: txnID, Detail: detail,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Hook(point, txnID string) bool {\n\treturn c.r.hookFired(c.owner, point, txnID)\n}\n\n// Runner 是一次模拟运行。\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc    Scenario\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\n\tnodes map[string]twopc.Node\n\tcoords map[string]*twopc.Coordinator\n\tparts  map[string]*twopc.Participant\n\twalh   map[string]*wal.WAL\n\tctxs   map[string]*runnerCtx\n\n\tdown      map[string]bool\n\tcrashes   map[string]*crashState\n\n\ttrace []TraceEntry\n}\n\n// New 构造一次运行（打开 WAL、创建节点，但不启动任何事件）。\nfunc New(sc Scenario) (*Runner, error) {\n\tsc = withDefaults(sc)\n\tif err := validate(sc); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdir := sc.DataDir\n\tif dir == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tdir, err = os.MkdirTemp(\"\", \"twopc-\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tsc.DataDir = dir\n\t}\n\tfresh := true\n\tif sc.Fresh != nil {\n\t\tfresh = *sc.Fresh\n\t}\n\tif fresh {\n\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(dir); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t} else if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tr := &Runner{\n\t\tsc:                sc,\n\t\tsched:             sim.New(sc.Seed),\n\t\tnodes:             map[string]twopc.Node{},\n\t\tcoords:            map[string]*twopc.Coordinator{},\n\t\tparts:             map[string]*twopc.Participant{},\n\t\twalh:              map[string]*wal.WAL{},\n\t\tctxs:              map[string]*runnerCtx{},\n\t\tdown:              map[string]bool{},\n\t\tcrashes:           map[string]*crashState{},\n\t}\n\n\t// 协调者。\n\tcw, err := wal.Open(dir, CoordinatorID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tcoord := twopc.NewCoordinator(CoordinatorID, cw, sc.Timings)\n\tcoord.SetTopology(ParticipantIDs())\n\tr.walh[CoordinatorID] = cw\n\tr.coords[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\tr.nodes[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\n\t// 参与者。\n\tpeersOf := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tvar peers []string\n\t\tfor _, other := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\t\tif other != id {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, other)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeersOf[id] = peers\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tpw, err := wal.Open(dir, id)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar voteNo []string\n\t\tfor _, t := range sc.Transactions {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range t.VoteNo {\n\t\t\t\tif v == id {\n\t\t\t\t\tvoteNo = append(voteNo, t.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tp := twopc.NewParticipant(id, CoordinatorID, peersOf[id], sc.Timings, pw, voteNo)\n\t\tr.walh[id] = pw\n\t\tr.parts[id] = p\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = p\n\t}\n\n\t// 每个节点一个绑定 owner 的上下文。\n\tfor id, n := range r.nodes {\n\t\tctx := &runnerCtx{owner: id, r: r}\n\t\tr.ctxs[id] = ctx\n\t\tswitch v := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *twopc.Coordinator:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\tcase *twopc.Participant:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 崩溃规则。\n\tfor i := range sc.Crashes {\n\t\tcr := sc.Crashes[i]\n\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d:%s:%s:%s:%d\", i, cr.NodeID, cr.Hook, cr.TxnID, cr.AtTick)\n\t\tr.crashes[key] = &crashState{rule: cr}\n\t}\n\treturn r, nil\n}\n\n// Run 执行模拟直到观察窗口结束。\nfunc (r *Runner) Run() {\n\t// Begin 事件。\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\tt := t\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"begin\", t.BeginTick, func() {\n\t\t\tif r.isUp(CoordinatorID) {\n\t\t\t\tr.coords[CoordinatorID].Begin(t.ID)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// atTick 崩溃事件（重启也在此规则内调度）。\n\tfor _, cs := range r.sortedCrashStates() {\n\t\tcs := cs\n\t\tif cs.rule.Hook != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"crashAtTick\", cs.rule.AtTick, func() {\n\t\t\tr.crashByRule(cs, \"atTick:\"+itoa(cs.rule.AtTick))\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tr.sched.Run(r.sc.MaxTick)\n\n\t// 记录观察窗口结束时各节点存活情况（证据）。\n\tfor id := range r.nodes {\n\t\tstate := \"up\"\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tstate = \"down\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sc.MaxTick, Node: id, Kind: \"endofwindow.\" + state,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) sortedCrashStates() []*crashState {\n\tvar out []*crashState\n\tfor _, cs := range r.crashes {\n\t\tout = append(out, cs)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].rule.AtTick != out[j].rule.AtTick {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].rule.AtTick < out[j].rule.AtTick\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].rule.NodeID < out[j].rule.NodeID\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) isUp(id string) bool { return !r.down[id] }\n\n// crashByRule 按某条注入规则触发崩溃，并安排其重启。\nfunc (r *Runner) crashByRule(cs *crashState, trigger string) {\n\tif r.down[cs.rule.NodeID] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcs.crashed = true\n\tr.crashNode(cs.rule.NodeID, trigger)\n\tif cs.rule.RestartTick > 0 {\n\t\tr.scheduleRestartByRule(cs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) crashNode(id, where string) {\n\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.down[id] = true\n\t// 崩溃 = 易失状态全部丢失：\n\t// 该节点待触发的定时器/发给它的消息，以及它已发出但尚在途的消息，一并消失。\n\towned, inFlight := r.sched.CancelNode(id)\n\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick:   r.sched.Now(),\n\t\tNode:   id,\n\t\tKind:   \"node.crash\",\n\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"trigger\": where, \"cancelledOwnedEvents\": owned, \"cancelledInFlight\": inFlight},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleRestartByRule(cs *crashState) {\n\tid := cs.rule.NodeID\n\tat := cs.rule.RestartTick\n\tdelay := at - r.sched.Now()\n\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"restart\", delay, func() {\n\t\tif !r.down[id] {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.down[id] = false\n\t\tcs.restarted = true\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sched.Now(), Node:       `json:\"txnId\"`\n\tVerdict       string           `json:\"verdict\"` // committed | aborted | blocked | partial-commit\n\tCommitted     []string         `json:\"committed\"`\n\tAborted       []string         `json:\"aborted\"`\n\tPrepared      []string         `json:\"prepared\"` // 窗口结束仍 prepared（持锁）的参与者\n\tUnknown       []string         `json:\"unknown\"`\n\tPartialCommit bool             `json:\"partialCommit\"` // true=出现部分参与者提交（协议被破坏）\n\tBlockedEvidence *BlockedEvidence `json:\"blockedEvidence,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// BlockedEvidence 展示“真的阻塞了”，而不是伪称可用。\ntype BlockedEvidence struct {\n\tCoordinatorAvailable bool                `json:\"coordinatorAvailable\"`\n\tParticipants         []BlockedPart       `json:\"participants\"`\n\tCoordinatorDecision  string `json:\"explanation\"`\n}\n\n// BlockedPart 是单个被阻塞参与者的持锁证据。\ntype BlockedPart struct {\n\tNodeID        string `json:\"nodeId\"`\n\tState         string `json:\"state\"`\n\tLockHeld      bool   `json:\"lockHeld\"`\n\tPreparedTick  int64  `json:\"preparedTick\"`\n\tWaitedTicks   int64  `json:\"waitedTicks\"`\n\tLastQueryTick int64  `json:\"lastQueryTick\"`\n\tQueriesSent   int    `json:\"queriesSent\"`\n}\n\n// QueryTickEvidence 记录一次询问周期的时刻。\ntype QueryTickEvidence struct {\n\tTick int64  `json:\"tick\"`\n\tFrom string `json:\"from\"`\n}\n\n// Report 是一次运行的完整 JSON 输出。\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario           string               `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed               int64                `json:\"seed\"`\n\tMaxTick            int64                `json:\"maxTick\"`\n\tDataDir            string               `json:\"dataDir\"`\n\tNetwork            NetworkCfg           `json:\"network\"`\n\tTimings            twopc.Timings        `json:\"timings\"`\n\tNodeSnapshots      []twopc.NodeSnapshot `json:\"nodeSnapshots\"`\n\tOutcomes           []TxnOutcome         `json:\"outcomes\"`\n\tVerdict            string               `json:\"verdict\"` // all-consistent | partial-commit-detected\n\tPartialCommits     []string             `json:\"partialCommits,omitempty\"`\n\tProtocolViolations []TraceEntry         `json:\"protocolViolations,omitempty\"`\n\tCrashes            []CrashSummary       `json:\"crashes\"`\n\tTrace              []TraceEntry         `json:\"trace\"`\n}\n\n// CrashSummary 汇总崩溃/重启是否按计划发生（验证注入生效）。\ntype CrashSummary struct {\n\tNodeID      string `json:\"nodeId\"`\n\tTrigger     string `json:\"trigger\"`\n\tCrashed     bool   `json:\"crashed\"`\n\tRestartTick int64  `json:\"restartTick,omitempty\"`\n\tRestarted   bool   `json:\"restarted\"`\n}\n\n// Report 生成最终报告。\nfunc (r *Runner) Report() *Report {\n\t// 1) 节点快照：存活用内存视图；宕机用磁盘 WAL 重放重建。\n\tnodeIDs := append([]string{CoordinatorID}, ParticipantIDs()...)\n\tsnaps := make([]twopc.NodeSnapshot, 0, len(nodeIDs))\n\tnodeStates := map[string]map[string]string{}\n\tfor _, id := range nodeIDs {\n\t\tvar snap twopc.NodeSnapshot\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.snapshotFromWAL(id)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tsnap = r.nodes[id].Snapshot()\n\t\t}\n\t\tsnaps = append(snaps, snap)\n\t\tstates := map[string]string{}\n\t\tfor txn, v := range snap.TxnStates {\n\t\t\tstates[txn] = v.State\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeStates[id] = states\n\t}\n\n\t// 2) 逐事务裁决。\n\toutcomes := make([]TxnOutcome, 0, len(r.sc.Transactions))\n\tvar partials []string\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\to := r.judgeTxn(t.ID, nodeStates)\n\t\tif o.PartialCommit {\n\t\t\tpartials = append(partials, t.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\toutcomes = append(outcomes, o)\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) 协议违规事件。\n\tvar violations []TraceEntry\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.Kind == \"participant.protocolViolation\" {\n\t\t\tviolations = append(violations, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tverdict := \"all-consistent\"\n\tif len(partials) > 0 {\n\t\tverdict = \"partial-commit-detected\"\n\t}\n\n\treturn &Report{\n\t\tScenario:           r.sc.Name,\n\t\tSeed:               r.sc.Seed,\n\t\tMaxTick:            r.sc.MaxTick,\n\t\tDataDir:            r.sc.DataDir,\n\t\tNetwork:            r.sc.Network,\n\t\tTimings:            r.sc.Timings,\n\t\tNodeSnapshots:      snaps,\n\t\tOutcomes:           outcomes,\n\t\tVerdict:            verdict,\n\t\tPartialCommits:     partials,\n\t\tProtocolViolations: violations,\n\t\tCrashes:            r.crashSummary(),\n\t\tTrace:              r.trace,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) judgeTxn(txnID string, nodeStates map[string]map[string]string) TxnOutcome {\n\to := TxnOutcome{TxnID: txnID}\n\tparts := append([]string{}, ParticipantIDs()...)\n\tsort.Strings(parts)\n\tfor _, p := range parts {\n\t\tst := nodeStates[p][txnID]\n\t\tif st == \"\" {\n\t\t\tst = twopc.StateUnknown\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch st {\n\t\tcase twopc.StateCommitted:\n\t\t\to.Committed = append(o.Committed, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StateAborted:\n\t\t\to.Aborted = append(o.Aborted, p)\n\t\tcase twopc.StatePrepared:\n\t\t\to.Prepared = append(o.Prepared, p)\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\to.Unknown = append(o.Unknown, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 无部分提交判定：\n\t// committed 与 (aborted|unknown) 并存 => 不可调和的分叉。\n\t// prepared 不算分叉：决议提交时它只是还没收到第二阶段，恢复后可收敛。\n\tif len(o.Committed) > 0 && (len(o.Aborted) > 0 || len(o.Unknown) > 0) {\n\t\to.PartialCommit = true\n\t\to.Verdict = \"partial-commit\"\n\t} else if len(o.Committed) == 3 {\n\t\to.Verdict = twopc.StateCommitted\n\t} else if len(o.Committed) > 0 && len(o.Prepared) > 0 {\n\t\t// 决议已提交，部分参与者尚停在 prepared（协调者此刻可能又宕机）=> 阻塞。\n\t\to.Verdict = \"blocked\"\n\t} else if len(o.Prepared) > 0 {\n\t\to.Verdict = \"blocked\"\n\t} else {\n\t\to.Verdict = twopc.StateAborted\n\t}\n\n\tif o.Verdict == \"blocked\" {\n\t\to.BlockedEvidence = r.blockedEvidence(txnID, nodeStates)\n\t}\n\treturn o\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) blockedEvidence(txnID string, nodeStates map[string]map[string]string) *BlockedEvidence {\n\tev := &BlockedEvidence{CoordinatorAvailable: !r.down[CoordinatorID]}\n\tswitch nodeStates[CoordinatorID][txnID] {\n\tcase twopc.StateCommitting:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"commit\"\n\tcase twopc.StateAborting:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"abort\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\tev.CoordinatorDecision = \"unknown\"\n\t}\n\n\t// 首次 PREPARED 时刻、询问次数（全部来自追踪事件）。\n\tprepTick := map[string]int64{}\n\tlastQuery := map[string]int64{}\n\tqueries := map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, e := range r.trace {\n\t\tif e.TxnID != txnID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif e.Kind == (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/sim\"\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/twopc\"\n\t\"twopcsim/internal/wal\"\n)\n\n// CoordinatorID 与参与者编号是固定拓扑（1 协调者 + 3 参与者）。\nconst CoordinatorID = \"coordinator\"\n\n// ParticipantIDs 返回固定的 3 个参与者 ID。\nfunc ParticipantIDs() []string { return []string{\"participant-1\", \"participant-2\", \"participant-3\"} }\n\n// TraceEntry 是一条协议追踪事件（报告证据）。\ntype TraceEntry struct {\n\tTick   int64             `json:\"tick\"`\n\tNode   string            `json:\"node\"`\n\tKind   string            `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTxnID  string            `json:\"txnId,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail map[string]any    `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\ntype crashState struct {\n\trule      CrashRule\n\thits      int\n\tdone      bool\n\tcrashed   bool // 规则确实触发过崩溃\n\trestarted bool // 规则配置的重启确实发生过\n}\n\n// runnerCtx 把节点协议代码与调度器/网络/故障注入连接起来。\ntype runnerCtx struct {\n\towner    string\n\tr        *Runner\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Now() int64 { return c.r.sched.Now() }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Send(m twopc.Message) { c.r.netSend(c.owner, m) }\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Timer(kind, txnID string, delay int64) {\n\towner := c.owner\n\tc.r.sched.Schedule(owner, \"timer:\"+kind, delay, func() {\n\t\tif !c.r.isUp(owner) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.r.nodes[owner].OnTimer(kind, txnID)\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Event(kind, txnID string, detail map[string]any) {\n\tc.r.trace = append(c.r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick: c.r.sched.Now(), Node: c.owner, Kind: kind, TxnID: txnID, Detail: detail,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *runnerCtx) Hook(point, txnID string) bool {\n\treturn c.r.hookFired(c.owner, point, txnID)\n}\n\n// Runner 是一次模拟运行。\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc    Scenario\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\n\tnodes map[string]twopc.Node\n\tcoords map[string]*twopc.Coordinator\n\tparts  map[string]*twopc.Participant\n\twalh   map[string]*wal.WAL\n\tctxs   map[string]*runnerCtx\n\n\tdown      map[string]bool\n\tcrashes   map[string]*crashState\n\n\ttrace []TraceEntry\n}\n\n// New 构造一次运行（打开 WAL、创建节点，但不启动任何事件）。\nfunc New(sc Scenario) (*Runner, error) {\n\tsc = withDefaults(sc)\n\tif err := validate(sc); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdir := sc.DataDir\n\tif dir == \"\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tdir, err = os.MkdirTemp(\"\", \"twopc-\")\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tsc.DataDir = dir\n\t}\n\tfresh := true\n\tif sc.Fresh != nil {\n\t\tfresh = *sc.Fresh\n\t}\n\tif fresh {\n\t\tif err := os.RemoveAll(dir); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t} else if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tr := &Runner{\n\t\tsc:                sc,\n\t\tsched:             sim.New(sc.Seed),\n\t\tnodes:             map[string]twopc.Node{},\n\t\tcoords:            map[string]*twopc.Coordinator{},\n\t\tparts:             map[string]*twopc.Participant{},\n\t\twalh:              map[string]*wal.WAL{},\n\t\tctxs:              map[string]*runnerCtx{},\n\t\tdown:              map[string]bool{},\n\t\tcrashes:           map[string]*crashState{},\n\t}\n\n\t// 协调者。\n\tcw, err := wal.Open(dir, CoordinatorID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tcoord := twopc.NewCoordinator(CoordinatorID, cw, sc.Timings)\n\tcoord.SetTopology(ParticipantIDs())\n\tr.walh[CoordinatorID] = cw\n\tr.coords[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\tr.nodes[CoordinatorID] = coord\n\n\t// 参与者。\n\tpeersOf := map[string][]string{}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tvar peers []string\n\t\tfor _, other := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\t\tif other != id {\n\t\t\t\tpeers = append(peers, other)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tpeersOf[id] = peers\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range ParticipantIDs() {\n\t\tpw, err := wal.Open(dir, id)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar voteNo []string\n\t\tfor _, t := range sc.Transactions {\n\t\t\tfor _, v := range t.VoteNo {\n\t\t\t\tif v == id {\n\t\t\t\t\tvoteNo = append(voteNo, t.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tp := twopc.NewParticipant(id, CoordinatorID, peersOf[id], sc.Timings, pw, voteNo)\n\t\tr.walh[id] = pw\n\t\tr.parts[id] = p\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = p\n\t}\n\n\t// 每个节点一个绑定 owner 的上下文。\n\tfor id, n := range r.nodes {\n\t\tctx := &runnerCtx{owner: id, r: r}\n\t\tr.ctxs[id] = ctx\n\t\tswitch v := n.(type) {\n\t\tcase *twopc.Coordinator:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\tcase *twopc.Participant:\n\t\t\tv.Bind(ctx)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 崩溃规则。\n\tfor i := range sc.Crashes {\n\t\tcr := sc.Crashes[i]\n\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d:%s:%s:%s:%d\", i, cr.NodeID, cr.Hook, cr.TxnID, cr.AtTick)\n\t\tr.crashes[key] = &crashState{rule: cr}\n\t}\n\treturn r, nil\n}\n\n// Run 执行模拟直到观察窗口结束。\nfunc (r *Runner) Run() {\n\t// Begin 事件。\n\tfor _, t := range r.sc.Transactions {\n\t\tt := t\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"begin\", t.BeginTick, func() {\n\t\t\tif r.isUp(CoordinatorID) {\n\t\t\t\tr.coords[CoordinatorID].Begin(t.ID)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// atTick 崩溃事件（重启也在此规则内调度）。\n\tfor _, cs := range r.sortedCrashStates() {\n\t\tcs := cs\n\t\tif cs.rule.Hook != \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"crashAtTick\", cs.rule.AtTick, func() {\n\t\t\tr.crashByRule(cs, \"atTick:\"+itoa(cs.rule.AtTick))\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tr.sched.Run(r.sc.MaxTick)\n\n\t// 记录观察窗口结束时各节点存活情况（证据）。顺序固定，保证确定性。\n\tfor _, id := range append([]string{CoordinatorID}, ParticipantIDs()...) {\n\t\tstate := \"up\"\n\t\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\t\tstate = \"down\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sc.MaxTick, Node: id, Kind: \"endofwindow.\" + state,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) sortedCrashStates() []*crashState {\n\tvar out []*crashState\n\tfor _, cs := range r.crashes {\n\t\tout = append(out, cs)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].rule.AtTick != out[j].rule.AtTick {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].rule.AtTick < out[j].rule.AtTick\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].rule.NodeID < out[j].rule.NodeID\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) isUp(id string) bool { return !r.down[id] }\n\n// crashByRule 按某条注入规则触发崩溃，并安排其重启。\nfunc (r *Runner) crashByRule(cs *crashState, trigger string) {\n\tif r.down[cs.rule.NodeID] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcs.crashed = true\n\tr.crashNode(cs.rule.NodeID, trigger)\n\tif cs.rule.RestartTick > 0 {\n\t\tr.scheduleRestartByRule(cs)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) crashNode(id, where string) {\n\tif r.down[id] {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tr.down[id] = true\n\t// 崩溃 = 易失状态全部丢失：\n\t// 该节点待触发的定时器/发给它的消息，以及它已发出但尚在途的消息，一并消失。\n\towned, inFlight := r.sched.CancelNode(id)\n\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\tTick:   r.sched.Now(),\n\t\tNode:   id,\n\t\tKind:   \"node.crash\",\n\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"trigger\": where, \"cancelledOwnedEvents\": owned, \"cancelledInFlight\": inFlight},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleRestartByRule(cs *crashState) {\n\tid := cs.rule.NodeID\n\tat := cs.rule.RestartTick\n\tdelay := at - r.sched.Now()\n\tr.sched.Schedule(\"system\", \"restart\", delay, func() {\n\t\tif !r.down[id] {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.down[id] = false\n\t\tcs.restarted = true\n\t\tr.trace = append(r.trace, TraceEntry{\n\t\t\tTick: r.sched.Now(), Node: id, Kind: \"node.restart\",\n\t\t\tDetail: map[string]any{\"wal\": filepath.Base(r.walh[id].Path()), \"restartAt\": at},\n\t\t})\n\t\t//
